problem: The Intent literal had fourteen values and none meant 'ask' or 'outside my scope', while the router prompt said 'Select the most specific intent even when no executable tool is available' — an instruction to guess. Measured over 225 utterances, confidence separated should-act from should-hold with AUC 0.642. The model answered 'call Marija' as SEND_EMAIL and 'print this document' as READ_EMAIL at confidence 1.00 on a machine with no telephony and no printer. Before any model ran, recognize() turned bare pronouns into arguments: 'отвори го' became open_app(app='го').
change: ASK and OUT_OF_SCOPE added to Intent; the instruction to guess replaced; the capability surface derived from catalogue() AND the machine limits derived from introspection.limits() injected into the prompt — the surface alone made the model refuse things ARIES does well, because a catalogue entry (set_brightness) exists for hardware that is absent. recognize() declines an argument that is only pronouns or clitics, or at two words a demonstrative plus a common noun. scripts/aries-verification-table generates docs/verification_table.md with --check.
validation: 225 utterances (actionable 100, ambiguous 55, out_of_scope 40, unsafe 30), qwen2.5:7b, threshold 0.82, own sqlite, nothing executed. Intents alone: 60.0% accuracy, 83% precision, 9/100 false holds. Plus capability surface: 60.4%, 95%, 2/100. Plus machine limits: 64.9%, 98%, 1/100 — past the 60.9% ceiling any confidence threshold reaches. out_of_scope explicitly held 0/40 -> 21/40. Pronoun guard through the live gate order in service.py: commitments on should-hold 23 -> 13, actionable unchanged 49 -> 49. tests: abstention_vocabulary 20, pronoun_arguments 26, intelligence 67, clarification 62, workspace 148.
limitations: Accuracy 60.4% did NOT beat the pre-registered 60.9%; only 64.9% did, after the limits clause. Choosing raw accuracy as the gate was a mistake: that 60.9% rule refuses 42 of 100 actionable requests at 65% precision against 1 of 100 at 98%. Recorded as an error in experiments/router-ood/REPORT.md. Recall is still poor: 78 of 125 should-hold utterances get an action intent, and prompt wording will not close it. One model, one threshold, one run; the fixture is written by one author, not transcribed. The verification-table generator was wrong four times (38->22->5->4 unproven) before the live ledger caught it; its delegate detection is name matching and the file says so.
